question: Is Uber's 31.6% slide to $63.47 a bargain entry on $10.42B FCF, or a Stage 4 trap masked by SBC, $1.5B HMRC VAT outflows, and $17.1B in pending M&A?

epigraph.quote: Price tells you what the market fears; the balance-sheet footnotes tell you what the market just discovered; the tape tells you when to stay out of the way.
epigraph.author: Executive Underwriting Summary

web_blocks.html: What Uber Does: Uber runs the world's largest urban ride and delivery network across 70+ countries [1, 2]. After selling ATG and Elevate in 2020 [10, 11], Uber built Uber One (>50M members) and Advertising (>$2.5B run-rate) [3, 19]. In Q3 2026, Gross Bookings rose 20% YoY to $59.82B (Q4 guided $63.25B–$65.25B) [31, 32]. Trailing Free Cash Flow hit $10.42B on 0.6% capex intensity [31]. Yet mid-2026 filings show a sharp M&A pivot ($14.8B Delivery Hero offer, $2.3B ezCater deal, $1.56B bolt-ons) [31, 33]. Long-term debt jumped 49% to $15,664M while quarterly buybacks fell 75% from Q1 to Q3 [31, 34, 35].

Our Independent Dual Verdict: Pass 1 kept COMPOUNDER_PASS with kpi_health: PASS_WITH_WATCH [31]. Watch items include Waymo, Tesla, and Zoox autonomous fleets, M&A debt, $13.71B insurance reserves ($11.37B restricted cash; $2.34B uncollateralized gap), and $3.4B UK HMRC back-VAT ($1.5B cash left to pay) [31]. Deducting $2.15B SBC, $7.67B net debt and leases, $1.50B UK VAT cash, and $10.65B net deal outlays puts shares at 17.12x normalized EV/(FCF-SBC). Base fair value is $75.00 ($70.14 standalone ex-M&A FCF; $65.50 after -$0.48B drag) with $45.00 Bear ($41.78 stressed) and $72.60 EV. Because shares closed November 20, 2026 at $63.47 in Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED) during a 10-day US Downtrend, new equity is REJECTED (TIER_0; TREND, CASH_FLOW). Common shares are NOT_HELD (0 shares). On the 5 open Dec 17, 2027 LEAPS (4x $110C, 1x $100C; 392 DTE; ~$820–$1,020 Black-Scholes value; $0.00 intrinsic at $75.00 Base), we mandate EXIT_IMMEDIATELY (CLOSE_INTO_CASH) to salvage cash cleanly rather than risking a gap below $63.00 ($0.47 away) and total theta decay.

Medium-Term (3–12 Months): REJECTED (TIER_0). $61.24–$63.10 ($60.96 stop) is purely a historical support reference below the $63.00 LEAPS floor (0.0% bids); require Stage 1 base + Stage 2 reclaim >$73.50 and Downtrend exit first.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our refreshed institutional dossier on Uber Technologies as of November 20, 2026. Over the past few days, a price-blind Pass 1 audit of Uber's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q uncovered critical facts that every owner and prospective buyer must weigh honestly. Operationally, Uber's core marketplace remains formidable: 215 million monthly users, 4,061 million quarterly trips, $59.82 billion in Q3 Gross Bookings (+20% YoY), and $10.42 billion in trailing twelve-month Free Cash Flow on 0.6% capital intensity. Yet beneath that headline strength, management executed a sharp mid-2026 capital-allocation pivot—launching a $14.8 billion takeover offer for Delivery Hero, agreeing to acquire ezCater for $2.3 billion, lifting long-term debt 49% to $15.66 billion, and cutting quarterly share buybacks 75% from Q1 to Q3—while disclosing $1.5 billion in pending UK HMRC back-VAT cash appeal outflows and explicit first-party autonomous competition from Waymo, Tesla, and Zoox.

When we re-run valuation cleanly in Pass 2 after deducting $2.15 billion in annualized stock-based compensation, $7.67 billion in forensic net debt and operating leases, $1.50 billion in UK VAT obligations, and $10.65 billion in net pending M&A outlays, Uber's $63.47 close ($129.60 billion market cap) equates to 17.12 times pro-forma normalized EV-to-FCF rather than the flattering 12.44 times headline ratio. Under our SBC-adjusted DCF, Base fair value is $75.00 (+18.2%)—or $70.14 standalone without the +$0.45 billion M&A FCF credit ($65.50 after -$0.48 billion drag)—against a $45.00 Bear case ($41.78 combined stress incorporating the $2.34 billion uncollateralized insurance gap) and $108.00 Bull case, producing a $72.60 primary expected value (+14.4%).

Even more decisive is the price tape. At $63.47, Uber sits in a confirmed Stan Weinstein Stage 4 breakdown (CAP_REJECTED)—12.32% below its 200-day average and just 18 cents above its $63.29 52-week low on 1.63 times normal volume—inside a 10-distribution-day US market Downtrend. Therefore, our New-Capital Verdict is strictly REJECTED (TIER_0; reasons: TREND and CASH_FLOW). The snapshot's $61.24–$63.10 band ($60.96 stop) is strictly a historical technical support reference below the $63.00 LEAPS floor, carrying 0.0% bids until a full Stage 1 base and Stage 2 reclaim above $73.50 form. We keep 100% of our $2,540.35 cash reserve (3.38% of $75,110.60 net worth versus a 22.0% Downtrend floor) in CASH—leaving shortlist ABBV ($286.20) and outside ACGL ($108.82) at 0% until liquidity recovers.

Finally, our existing portfolio holds zero common Uber shares (NOT_HELD), but carries 5 open December 17, 2027 Call LEAPS contracts in Robinhood (4x $110C and 1x $100C; $3,463.86 cost; $1,775.86 prior mark; 392 DTE as of November 20, 2026). Because both strikes expire at $0.00 intrinsic value even at our $75.00 Base Case, $63.47 sits just $0.47 (under 0.2x ATR) above $63.00 on 1.63x Stage 4 volume, option spreads exceed 14%, and portfolio US cash is starved at 3.38%, we override the scanner and mandate EXIT_IMMEDIATELY (CLOSE_INTO_CASH) across all 5 contracts to salvage ~$820–$1,020 into USD cash cleanly, with zero averaging down and hard invalidation <= $63.00.

Across our three time horizons, patience protects compounding. For 1 to 12 weeks, stay away from Stage 4 distribution. For 3 to 12 months, new capital is REJECTED (TIER_0) until price builds a Stage 1 base and reclaims $72.40–$73.50 on heavy volume. For 2 to 5 years, track Delivery Hero leverage (<2.0x), UK VAT resolution, and Waymo partner economics closely. Chapters 1 through 9 below lay out every number and trigger behind that judgment.

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION: WHEN THE THESIS AND TAPE BOTH DEMAND DISCIPLINE
book_callouts.text: Pass 1 showed that Uber's operating flywheel is intact, yet its balance sheet and capital allocation grew markedly riskier in mid-2026. Paired with a Stage 4 breakdown 47 cents above a critical floor, discipline means rejecting new equity entries today and closing all 5 out-of-the-money Dec 2027 LEAPS into cash immediately.
